name: THE EMPTY STOREFRONT
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE SIGN
LOOK_AT: HARDWARE & SUNDRIES. The paint is good. It was done by a professional, recently, at expense.
It's leaning on the wall instead of hanging over the door. They had it painted and then never put it up.
The letters are gold-edged. Somebody spent money on the sign before they spent it on anything else. That's a kind of hope.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. A sign with nothing to say about the shop it's for.
The sign shifting a little against the wall when I walk past, then deciding against it.

overrides.PICK_UP: It's somebody's. They paid for it. They'll want it, when they come back, which they won't.

subjects.name: THE SWEPT FLOOR
LOOK_AT: Somebody swept up before they left. On the last day, they swept.
There's a pile of sweepings in the corner, neatly gathered, and nobody came back for the pan.
Swept to the corners, swept under the counter. It's the cleanest floor in town, and nobody walks on it.
LISTEN_TO: My own boots on it, louder than they ought to be.
Nothing. Even the dust has left.

subjects.name: THE COUNTER
LOOK_AT: A counter with nothing on it but a square of cleaner wood, where a cash box sat until the end.
There's a notch cut in the edge, for measuring rope by the yard. Someone measured a lot of rope here.
A ledger shelf underneath. Empty. They took the books. Nobody leaves the books.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. I rapped on it, the way you would, and nobody came.
Hollow, when I knock. A good counter rings like that.
Nothing. It's waiting for a customer, like every counter in this territory.

overrides.PUSH: It's built in. Everything in the shop that could leave has left.

subjects.name: THE WINDOW
LOOK_AT: A shop window with the price tickets still stuck to the inside of the glass. The goods have gone. The prices stayed, out of loyalty.
NAILS 5¢ LB. LAMP OIL 30¢. The last prices in this shop, kept clear in the window, like a memorial.
The glass is clean. They cleaned the window on the way out, so nobody would think badly of them.
LISTEN_TO: The street outside, going past. It has stopped looking in.
A wagon going by, and not slowing.
The glass humming faintly in the wind. It holds a note. The note is flat.

subjects.name: THE BACK ROOM
LOOK_AT: The back room: empty shelves, and one crate, labelled NAILS, that is empty too. They took the nails.
Marks on the floor where heavy things stood for a long time and then didn't.
A calendar on a nail, turned to a month two years ago. That's when they stopped turning it.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. A back room with nothing in it is the quietest place a man can stand.
Nothing. Nothing at all, which is a great deal of nothing for one room.
A mouse, somewhere, also deciding there's nothing here.

overrides.OPEN: It's open. There's nothing in it to keep in.
